name: Official Predictor Evaluation Contract
purpose: Evaluate the deployable motion predictor on the frozen official WOMD validation corpus and emit provenance-complete predictions for Stage 06.
acceptance_criteria: official_validation data are separate from training/development data
no future ground-truth information is used as predictor input
checkpoint and preprocessing hashes are recorded
scenario_id and track_id are retained for every prediction
prediction horizon and tensor shapes match the canonical Stage-01 contract
failed/filtered samples are explicitly accounted for
publication status remains BLOCKED until the real official validation corpus and frozen predictor artifacts are available
forbidden: synthetic data presented as official validation
development data presented as official validation
future labels used as predictor inputs
